    How to Play

    Super short rules from Teach Pack — tap tabs, flip tips, try a quick check.

    Win the match

    Both heroes start at 40 HP. Drop the enemy hero to 0 to win.

    You are the bottom hero. Opponent is the top.

    Quick check — tap the right answer:

    Each turn

    Mana up→Draw→Play & attack→End turn
    1. Start — gain mana (turn 1 = 1 crystal, up to 10). Draw 1 card.
    2. Main — play Creatures, Spells, Traps (pay cost). Attack with ready creatures.
    3. End — press End Turn. Opponent plays.

    DDL Coin If you go second, once per game you may spend the Coin to play a card that costs 1 more than your current mana.

    Unspent mana does not carry over to the next turn.

    Three card types

    Card cost = top-left diamond. Your mana is the blue number by your hero (current / max).

    Hand max is 10. Extra draws when full go to the graveyard.

    How combat works

    1. Tap a ready creature (yours, glowing).
    2. Tap a legal target — enemy creature or the enemy hero.
    3. Trade damage. Equal ATK kills both (equal-ATK kill).

    Summoning sickness — a creature cannot attack the turn it was played, unless it has Rush (creatures only that turn — never face).

    You can stack several attackers into one target when legal.

    Can a brand-new creature attack face the turn you play it?

    Keywords (tap each)

    Tip: the big name on a card is the hero/name. Keywords are separate tags (e.g. Dash is a name — Stone is a keyword).

    Pick your path

    • Teach Pack — guided first lesson (recommended once).
    • Vs Bot — Easy or Advanced AI. Finish matches to earn Miles.
    • BOOST — both start at 10 mana (fast, high-curve).
    • Vs Pack (PvP) — Find Match or Duel with a code. Live games are watchable; duel codes only join with the code.

    Ready for the interactive lesson? Start Teach Pack from the home coins — or close this and try a bot game.
